tables.caption: Characteristics of included systematic reviews
tables.foot_markup:
AMSTAR 2 is a critical appraisal tool for systematic reviews.31

Data presented are for all the papers included in the systematic reviews and may include exposures other than CRF and/or participants aged >18 years.

Details on the AMSTAR 2 quality assessment are available inonline supplemental eTable 2.

CRF includes different measures of CRF, but all have been included under the bucket of CRF.

One study was classified as including both cross-sectional and longitudinal design elements, and one study was classified as being both cross-sectional and interventional.
